name_reason: Already fully compliant with the global naming convention: data_fd2_ prefix, _battle_ core-table marker, summon_anim_variant_c semantic descriptor (the 'c' is the animation variant letter, a domain descriptor, NOT a Ghidra address residue), and swap_done_latch reflects both role (records the state-3 swap was performed) and data type (latch = boolean flag). No hex address residue. Live Ghidra symbol matches byte-identical.
purpose: One-shot latch guarding the state-3 transition of the variant-C 5-slot radial summon animation, ensuring the per-slot setup (x-slot 2/4 swap, y-coord copy, frame/blit counter seeding) runs exactly once per animation run.
logic_summary: Host fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_c_5slot_radial @0x26E39 owns all three accesses. state-0 INIT clears it to 0 (MOV byte [0x54096],0 @0x26ED6). state-3 reads it via MOVZX (@0x26EEC) and TESTs: when 0, it performs the one-time transition (swap x_coord[2]<->x_coord[4], y_coord[2]<-y_coord[4], y_coord[4]<-angle_accumulator, seed 5-slot frame_counter to -i and blit_counter to 0) then sets the latch to 1 (MOV byte [0x54096],1 @0x26F3F) so the block never repeats while state 3 is re-entered. No other function references it.
element_semantics: Single unsigned 8-bit boolean flag: 0 = state-3 setup not yet done this run, 1 = done. Every access is byte-width; the read uses MOVZX (zero-extend).
notes: Memory at 0x54096 reads 0x00 (zero-bss runtime scratch), matching is_const=false (game writes it at 0x26ED6 and 0x26F3F). Ghidra defined data type confirmed byte LEN=1. Ghidra PLATE_COMMENT was null (no existing plate) -> created a concise plate via cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...) consistent with the src comment. src comment block (anisummn.c lines 1439-1454) was already precise and accurate; left unchanged (comment_verdict=keep). No src edit made, so anisummn.c is not in the commit; only the shard is staged.
